items.title: Louis Cottrell, Jr. Interview, 1961-08-25
items.q: It's Wilhelmina Barth Duroon. That's her name. D-U. Yeah. That's right. I remember there is another name.

ctx.x: Yeah, Bunk used to talk about it too. I knew Bunk by the way. Yeah. Used to be a pianist at some of those Sunday concerts, as they called them, and they used to give. Barth. Barth. B-A-R-T-H-E-N. T-H-E-N. T-H-E-N. Oh, B-A-R-T. It may be B-A-R-T. Anyway, they'll never talk about it.
It's Wilhelmina Barth Duroon. That's her name. D-U. Yeah. That's right. I remember there is another name. D-U. Oh.
That's right. I remember there is another name.
